title: Bank Deposit Late-Delivery Refunds and the Size of the Principal
content:
When a Bank Deposit transfer is owed a late-delivery refund, principal points follow the principal collected on that transfer. Each principal point is one percentage point added to the late-delivery refund share of the transfer.

**Principal collected** is the total of the funds-received entries on the transfer's ledger, that is, the customer's payment for the principal as collected by card or pay-by-bank capture, ACH settlement or wire arrival.

## Clause

A principal at or above 5000 US dollars earns 10 principal points; a principal at or above 2000 US dollars but below 5000 US dollars earns 5 principal points; any smaller principal earns no principal points.

## Bands

| Principal collected (USD) | Principal points |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 10 |
| 2000.00 up to 4999.99 | 5 |
| below 2000.00 | 0 |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical principals)

| Principal collected | Points |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 | 10 |
| 4999.99 | 5 |
| 2000.00 | 5 |
| 1999.99 | 0 |

## Points of judgement

- **A transfer whose principal was collected in one wire arrival of 7500.00.** 7500.00 is at or above 5000, so 10 points.
- **An ACH-funded transfer of 1500.00 whose debit has settled.** Below 2000, so no principal points.
- **The fee is not part of the principal.** Only the funds received for the principal are read; fee charges do not count toward the bands.
